IMPORTANT: two different sources feed the same shape into this screen — CreatorDashboard.tsx (the actual /creator route) reads the module-level `currentSession` singleton directly (src/lib/api/mocks/session.ts), completely bypassing the real auth session-provider; HomeRightRail.tsx's CreatorRail instead reads `useSession().user` (the SessionUser populated by real sign-in). The two never disagree today only because the mock singleton and the mock sign-in flow happen to be seeded consistently — once a real backend exists this is a genuine seam gap: the main dashboard page has no wired GET for 'who is the current creator', it needs to be pointed at the session/profile endpoint the same way HomeRightRail already is.

gates.canEarn === false (creator.kyc !== 'approved') — shows the warning-tint 'KYC in review — 1 to 3 days' banner and the 'Held — not payable yet' pill, on both mobile and desktop
gates.canEarn === true (creator.kyc === 'approved') — shows the 'Paid out to GTB ••••6789' success pill and includes both payable and held amounts in the displayed total
approved === true AND currentMessaging.threads contains at least one thread with opened === false
approved === false, OR every thread has opened === true
currentMessaging.threads contains a thread with expiresAt set (buyer has opened it, 24h reply window actively counting down)

libraryItems.filter(i => i.status === 'live').length === 0 (brand-new creator with nothing live yet, or everything still in review/rejected)

This is a resolved, documented divergence, not a gap.

The D6 desktop design's header 'Statement' download button (icon=Download) has NO corresponding implementation anywhere in CreatorDashboard.tsx's desktop JSX, and carries no comment explaining the omission — unlike the Withdraw panel, this divergence is undocumented and unflagged in code.

Design's D6 stat row shows 'Unlocks: 86' and 'Questions answered: 19' as static mockup numbers; the shipped code keeps 'Unlocks' fully hardcoded to '86' with no backing field/variable at all (not even a SEAM comment), while 'Questions answered' is correctly wired to the live responseStats.responded count. The 'Unlocks' stat is an additional undocumented hardcode beyond the ones already listed in stubs.json (STUB-5/STUB-12) — worth flagging for a future stub-discovery pass.
